arxiv-2203-11668.title: Chiral fermions, dimensional regularization, and the trace anomaly
arxiv-2203-11668.description: Abstract We investigate the trace anomaly of a chiral fermion in dimensional regularization, considering in detail the simplest case of coupling to an abelian gauge field. We apply the Breitenlohner-Maison/’t Hooft-Veltman prescription for dealing with the chiral matrix γ 5 \gamma^{5} and verify that no parity-odd term arises in the trace anomaly.

arxiv-2210-00301.title: Learning Globally Smooth Functions on Manifolds
arxiv-2210-00301.creator: Juan Cerviño, Luiz F.O. Chamon, Benjamin D. Haeffele, Rene Vidal, Alejandro Ribeiro
arxiv-2210-00301.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Juan Cerviño, Luiz F.O. Chamon, Benjamin D. Haeffele, Rene Vidal, Alejandro Ribeiro. Smoothness and low dimensional structures play central roles in improving generalization and stability in learning and statistics. This work combines techniques from semi-infinite constrained learning and manifold regularization to learn representations that are globally smooth on a manifold. To do so, it shows that under typical conditions the problem of learning a Lipschitz continuous function on a manifold is equivalent to a dynamically weighted manifold regularization problem.

arxiv-2302-11985.title: Automatic Detecting Unethical Behavior in Open-source Software Projects
arxiv-2302-11985.creator: Hsu Myat Win, Haibo Wang, Shin Hwei Tan
arxiv-2302-11985.description: Abstract . Given the rapid growth of Open-Source Software (OSS) projects, ethical considerations are becoming more important. Past studies focused on specific ethical issues (e.g., gender bias and fairness in OSS). There is little to no study on the different types of unethical behavior in OSS projects.

arxiv-2306-01287.title: An experimental investigation of droplet morphology in swirl flow
arxiv-2306-01287.creator: Pavan Kumar Kirar, 1 Surendra Kumar Soni, 2 Pankaj S. Kolhe 2 † \dagger, Kirti Chandra Sahu 1
arxiv-2306-01287.description: Abstract The interaction of a droplet with a swirling airstream is investigated experimentally by shadowgraphy and particle image velocimetry techniques. In swirl flow, the droplet experiences oppose-flow, cross-flow, and co-flow conditions depending on its ejection location, the velocity of the airstream, and swirl strength, which results in distinct droplet morphologies as compared to the straight airflow situation.

arxiv-2312-05334.title: ProsDectNet: Bridging the Gap in Prostate Cancer Detection via Transrectal B-mode Ultrasound Imaging
arxiv-2312-05334.creator: Sulaiman Vesal, Indrani Bhattacharya, Hassan Jahanandish, Xinran Li, Zachary Kornberg, Steve Ran Zhou, Elijah Richard Sommer, Moon Hyung Choi, Richard E. Fan, Geoffrey A. Sonn, Mirabela Rusu
arxiv-2312-05334.description: Abstract Interpreting traditional B-mode ultrasound images can be challenging due to image artifacts (e.g., shadowing, speckle), leading to low sensitivity and limited diagnostic accuracy. While Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) has been proposed as a solution, it is expensive and not widely available.

arxiv-2410-05348.title: Influence of GUP corrected Casimir energy on zero tidal force wormholes in modified teleparallel gravity with matter coupling
arxiv-2410-05348.creator: Mohammed Muzakkir Rizwan, Zinnat Hassan, P.K. Sahoo, Ali Övgün
arxiv-2410-05348.description: Abstract In recent times, the study of the Casimir effect in quantum field theory has garnered increasing attention because of its potential to be an ideal source of exotic matter needed for stabilizing traversable wormholes. It has been confirmed through experimental evidence that this phenomenon involves fluctuations in the vacuum field, leading to a negative energy density.

arxiv-2510-12543.title: The Diameter of (Threshold) Geometric Inhomogeneous Random Graphs
arxiv-2510-12543.creator: Zylan Benjert, Kostas Lakis, Johannes Lengler, Raghu Raman Ravi
arxiv-2510-12543.description: Abstract We prove that the diameter of threshold (zero temperature) Geometric Inhomogeneous Random Graphs (GIRG) is Θ ⁡ ( log ⁡ n ) \Theta(\log n) . This has strong implications for the runtime of many distributed protocols on those graphs, which often have runtimes bounded as a function of the diameter.

arxiv-2601-20459.title: Challenges in Android Data Disclosure: An Empirical Study Conference: IEEE/ACM 9th International Conference on Mobile Software Engineering and Systems; April 12, 2026; Rio de Janeiro, Brazil IEEE/ACM 9th International Conference on Mobile Software Engineering and Systems (MOBILESoft ’26), April 12,
arxiv-2601-20459.creator: Mugdha Khedkar, Michael Schlichtig, Mohamed Soliman, Eric Bodden
arxiv-2601-20459.description: Abstract . Current legal frameworks enforce that Android developers accurately report the data their apps collect. However, large codebases can make this reporting challenging. This paper employs an empirical approach to understand developers’ experience with Google Play Store’s Data Safety Section (DSS) form.

pmc-10645363.title: A Bayesian method to infer copy number clones from single-cell RNA and ATAC sequencing
pmc-10645363.creator: Lucrezia Patruno, Salvatore Milite, Riccardo Bergamin, Nicola Calonaci, Alberto D’Onofrio, Fabio Anselmi, Marco Antoniotti, Alex Graudenzi, Giulio Caravagna, Teresa M. Przytycka, Jian Ma, Teresa M. Przytycka, Jian Ma
pmc-10645363.description: Single-cell RNA and ATAC sequencing technologies enable the examination of gene expression and chromatin accessibility in individual cells, providing insights into cellular phenotypes. In cancer research, it is important to consistently analyze these states within an evolutionary context on genetic clones.

pmc-11420633.title: Diffuse pulmonary meningotheliomatosis: A case report
pmc-11420633.creator: Su Ji Oh, Jun Hyeok Lim, Lucia Kim, Young Sam Kim
pmc-11420633.description: A 57-year-old female presented with chest discomfort and exertional dyspnea but no other respiratory symptoms or history of malignancy. Chest CT revealed multifocal centrilobular nodules with ground-glass opacity in both lungs. Thoracoscopic wedge resection was done, and histological examination confirmed interstitial meningothelial-like nodules, consistent with diffuse meningotheliomatosis.

pmc-11466819.title: Whole exome sequencing identifies a novel mutation in Annexin A4 that is associated with recurrent spontaneous abortion
pmc-11466819.creator: Qian Ye, Fa-Ying Liu, Xiao-Jian Xia, Xiao-Yong Chen, Li Zou, Hui-Min Wu, Dan-Dan Li, Chen-Nian Xia, Ting Huang, Ying Cui, Yang Zou
pmc-11466819.description: BackgroundRecurrent spontaneous abortion (RSA) is a multifactorial disease, the exact causes of which are still unknown. Environmental, maternal, and genetic factors have been shown to contribute to this condition. The aim of this study was to investigate the presence of mutations in the ANXA4 gene in patients with RSA.

pmc-11527279.title: The SARS-CoV-2 ORF6 protein inhibits nuclear export of mRNA and spliceosomal U snRNA
pmc-11527279.creator: Ichiro Taniguchi
pmc-11527279.description: Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) is the causative agent of coronavirus disease 19 (COVID-19). SARS-CoV-2 infection suppresses host innate immunity and impairs cell viability. Among the viral proteins, ORF6 exhibits potent interferon (IFN) antagonistic activity and cellular toxicity.

pmc-11591641.title: LEGO®-Based Therapy in School Settings for Social Behavior Stimulation in Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder: Comparing Peer-Mediated and Expert Intervention
pmc-11591641.creator: Luciana Oliveira Angelis, Fernanda Tebexreni Orsati, Maria Cristina Triguero Veloz Teixeira, Domingo Garcia-Villamisar, María Álvarez-Couto, Gema Pilar Saez Suanes
pmc-11591641.description: Background: LEGO®-based therapy is a social development protocol that uses LEGO® activities to support the development of a wide range of interaction skills, enhancing prosocial behaviors and mitigating the challenges associated with mental health difficulties and behavioral issues commonly observed in children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD).

pmc-13132639.title: Association Between the ERVW-1 Gene Polymorphism (rs4727276) and the Pathogenesis of Preeclampsia: A Case-Control Study in Women From Northeast Brazil
pmc-13132639.creator: Gelton Fonteles, José Juvenal Linhares, Anderson Weiny Barbalho Silva, Jackson do Nascimento Costa, Louhanna Pinheiro Rodrigues Teixeira, Lailton Oliveira da Silva, Aridenio Dayvid da Silva, Alisson Araujo Gomes, Thaís Torres Fonteles, Janssen Loiola Melo Vasconcelos
pmc-13132639.description: BackgroundPreeclampsia (PE) is a pregnancy-related hypertensive disorder and a major cause of maternal, fetal, and neonatal morbidity and mortality. Genetic susceptibility plays an important role in its pathogenesis, and molecular biomarkers involved in placental development, such as variants of the ERVW-1 gene, have gained increasing attention.

pmc-13264677.title: How Lived Experience Advisory Groups Contribute to the Design and Conduct of Mental Health Research
pmc-13264677.creator: Jo Evans, Samuel Keightley, Angela Sweeney, Rosie Hill, Ezekiel Khayri, Sarah Markham, Til Wykes
pmc-13264677.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionThe positive impact of patient and public involvement (PPI) on the relevance, accessibility and acceptability of mental health research is well documented. Much of this reporting comes from researchers; less is known about the perspectives of PPI contributors.

pmc-13351072.title: Intelligent monitoring system for pipeline status based on MEMS acoustic emission sensors
pmc-13351072.creator: Tao Liu, Wenwu Yan, Dongxiao Li, Jidong Cai, Jian Feng, Hanjie Dou, Jiaqian Yang, Pengfan Wu, Hongliang Wang, Xiaojing Mu
pmc-13351072.description: Pipeline structural health monitoring is critical for global energy security, yet traditional bulk piezoelectric acoustic emission (AE) sensors are inherently bulky, narrow-band, and unsuitable for large-scale, distributed deployment. Here, we present a highly integrated, broadband microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) AE sensor based on ScAlN piezoelectric micromachined ultrasonic transducers (PMUTs) for intelligent pipeline damage monitoring.

pmc-13359366.title: Advancements in single-molecule fluorescence spectroscopy for probing conformations, dynamics, and interactions in disordered protein regions
pmc-13359366.creator: Drake Jensen, Jasmine Cubuk, Nirnay Samanta, Melissa D Stuchell-Brereton, Andrea Soranno
pmc-13359366.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Single-molecule fluorescence spectroscopy encompasses a range of techniques to probe dynamic conformational ensembles of intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs). By resolving subpopulation-specific properties and spanning timescales from nanoseconds to seconds, these measurements provide observables often inaccessible with ensemble measurements. Here, we contextualize key challenges and recent advances, including integrating experiments, simulations, and theory to quantify sequence-encoded effects, as well as photon statistic analyses to characterize protein dynamics.

pmc-13391380.title: The interplay between stack pressure, mechanical expansion and degradation pathways in lithium-ion batteries
pmc-13391380.creator: Heng Wang, Rui Wang, Christopher A O’Keefe, Erik Björklund, Daniela Proprentner, Joe C Stallard, Hwee Jien Tan, Wesley M Dose, Louis F J Piper, Robert S Weatherup, Angkur J D Shaikeea, Clare P Grey, Michael De Volder
pmc-13391380.description: While electrochemical degradation mechanisms in lithium-ion batteries are well studied, the influence of mechanical factors remains poorly understood. Here we introduce a high-precision stack-pressure control and dilatometry tool to apply a uniform and constant stack pressure on electrodes independent of electrode swelling. By increasing stack pressure fourfold over typical initial values, we double the lifetime of graphite ‖ LiNi0.8Mn0.1Co0.

pmc-13407409.title: Psychological Aspects of Rheumatic Diseases: Psychorheumatology in Clinical Practice
pmc-13407409.creator: Domniki M. Karagianni, Christina G. Katsiari, Konstantinos Bonotis, Lazaros I. Sakkas

pmc-13585787.title: Epidemiology of spinal fractures in polytrauma patients
pmc-13585787.creator: Stephanus Jacobus Malan, Simone Meakes, Angela Fischer, Zsolt J. Balogh
pmc-13585787.description: PurposeThe epidemiology of spinal fractures in polytrauma, population characteristics and their hospital outcomes are not well defined. This study aimed to describe the epidemiology and outcomes of spinal fractures in a consensus defined polytrauma cohort.MethodsA 13-year (2009–2021) retrospective study was conducted on Newcastle Definition based polytrauma patients at a Level-1 centre.
